paragraphs.title: Management Philosophy
paragraphs.en: Customer success comes first. Our priority is to help merchants succeed, creating a win-win partnership for both sides. Ultimately, merchants and users are our most important customers, and their success drives our success.
paragraphs.cn: 客户成功第一。我们的首要任务是帮助商户成功，创造双方共赢的合作关系。商户和用户是我们最重要的客户，他们的成功推动我们的成功。
paragraphs.scene: Management philosophy kickoff / 管理理念宣导

paragraphs.title: People Development
paragraphs.en: People are Keeta's most valuable asset. Developing people is the only way to build a sustainable organization and business. It is both our responsibility and our mission. When we develop people, we build strong execution, long-term growth, and alignment in mindset and culture.
paragraphs.cn: 人才是Keeta最宝贵的资产。培养人才是建设可持续组织和业务的唯一道路。这既是我们的责任，也是我们的使命。培养人才能带来强执行、长期增长，以及思维和文化的一致。
paragraphs.scene: People development / 人才发展

paragraphs.title: Know-How
paragraphs.en: We must know how to do the work well. Before focusing on the outcome, we need to continuously explore better ways of working, accumulate best practices, document them into clear processes, and make them repeatable and scalable. That's what know-how means.
paragraphs.cn: 我们必须掌握把工作做好的方法。在只关注结果之前，我们需要持续探索更好的工作方式，积累最佳实践，将其沉淀为清晰流程，并使其可复制、可规模化。这就是know-how的含义。
paragraphs.scene: Know-how / 方法论阐述

paragraphs.title: Metric Shift: From Quantity to Quality
paragraphs.en: Switching from "RED Operating Meet Rate" to "RED Order Penetration Rate" is essentially a shift from quantity to quality. What we want is not the number of operating merchants, but high-quality merchants who can consistently generate orders. The old metric could not identify the problem when top merchants by order volume were all among those not operating. The new metric directly tells us — we missed the big fish and need to go after the top merchants.
paragraphs.cn: 从"RED营业达标率"切换为"RED订单渗透率"，本质上是从"量"转向"质"。我们要的不是上线商家的数字，而是能持续产生订单的高质量商家。旧指标在订单量最高的头部商家未营业时发现不了问题。新指标直接告诉我们——大头没抓住，得去攻头部。
paragraphs.scene: Strategic metric transition explanation / 战略指标转型说明

paragraphs.title: Ownership & Accountability
paragraphs.en: Every lead must be assigned to a specific BD. No merchant should be left without an owner. If a lead has no assigned BD, accountability falls on the BDM and the CM. Clear ownership is the foundation of execution — without it, nothing gets done.
paragraphs.cn: 每条线索必须分配给具体BD。不能有商户没有负责人。如果线索未分配BD，责任由BDM和CM承担。明确的责任归属是执行力的基础——没有归属，什么都做不成。
paragraphs.scene: Ownership & accountability / 责任归属强调

paragraphs.title: Pipeline Review
paragraphs.en: BDMs must review each BD's lead pipeline every day. CMs must conduct pipeline reviews at least twice a week, with a mandatory face-to-face business review every Thursday together with the BDMs. The main focus should be on high-priority merchants with 20 or more daily orders. We verify the facts behind the progress, understand the reasons for merchants who have not signed yet, and coach BDs on their next action plans.
paragraphs.cn: BDM必须每日复盘每位BD的线索管道。CM每周至少两次进行管道复盘，并在每周四与BDM一起开展强制面对面业务复盘。重点关注日均20单以上的高优先级商户。我们要核实进展背后的真实情况，了解商户未签约的原因，并辅导BD制定下一步行动计划。
paragraphs.scene: Pipeline review mechanism / 商机复盘机制

paragraphs.title: Coaching on the Ground
paragraphs.en: Help BDs identify the real facts behind each opportunity. Determine whether the issue is related to execution or capability — for example: no KP contact information, unable to schedule a meeting, the KP has no interest, no SK prepared, or weak sales scripts. BDMs should coach BDs on their daily visit plans, join customer visits, and provide on-the-job coaching to improve execution and closing capability.
paragraphs.cn: 帮助BD识别每个商机背后的真实情况。判断问题是出在执行还是能力——例如：没有KP联系方式、无法约见、KP没有兴趣、没有准备SK、话术薄弱。BDM应辅导BD的日常拜访计划，参与客户拜访，提供现场辅导，提升执行和成交能力。
paragraphs.scene: On-the-job coaching / 现场辅导

paragraphs.title: SK Quality
paragraphs.en: A high-quality Sales Kit is critical for key merchants. The quality of the SK directly determines whether the KP is willing to sign the partnership. Before meeting a KP, investigate the merchant's daily orders, dining situation, reviews, and operational pain points. Then summarize the findings in a one-page SK that clearly explains Keeta's solution and value proposition.
paragraphs.cn: 高质量销售工具包对重点商户至关重要。SK的质量直接决定KP是否愿意签署合作。约见KP前，先调研商户日订单、堂食情况、评价和经营痛点。再将洞察总结为一页SK，清晰说明Keeta解决方案和价值主张。
paragraphs.scene: Sales preparation / 销售方案准备

paragraphs.title: Penetration Rate Target & Gap
paragraphs.en: The current RED order penetration rate for merchants operating on both Keeta and RED is 75.6%, with a target of 85%, leaving an overall gap of 9.4%, corresponding to a RED order target of 12,512 orders. Due to differences in current performance across regions, targets vary: Eastern Region target is 87%, Western Region target is 82%, and Metropolitan target is 86%. We have screened the top 2,000 RED merchants not yet operating on Keeta as a priority pool.
paragraphs.cn: 目前Keeta和RED双营业商家的RED订单渗透率为75.6%，目标85%，整体差距9.4%，对应RED订单目标12,512单。因各区域现状值有差异，目标略有不同：东区87%，西区82%，都市圈86%。我们筛选了RED排名前2,000未在Keeta营业的商家作为重点做功池。
paragraphs.scene: Target alignment presentation / 目标对齐汇报

paragraphs.title: Battle Focus: Three Directions
paragraphs.en: The three focus areas are not signed, not operating, and not online merchants. Not signed merchants have the highest volume and point value — securing them drives the biggest penetration rate improvement. Not operating merchants need activation through visits and coaching. Not online merchants need onboarding support. Each merchant in the priority pool should be assigned to a specific BD with clear follow-up deadlines.
paragraphs.cn: 三大攻坚方向是未签约、未营业和未上线商户。未签约商户数量最多、分值最高——攻克他们对渗透率提升贡献最大。未营业商户需要通过拜访和辅导激活。未上线商户需要上线支持。重点池中每家商户应分配给具体BD，明确跟进截止日。
paragraphs.scene: Battle plan breakdown / 作战计划分解

paragraphs.title: Milestones & Timeline
paragraphs.en: The city kick-off meeting and BD allocation happen on Monday. Every Thursday, the CM reviews each BDM team's progress and merchant pipeline. By the 15th, 60% of the goal should be achieved. On the 18th, cities below 60% must present a performance review and improvement plan. By the 24th, 100% of the goal should be achieved. This cadence ensures we catch problems early and course-correct in time.
paragraphs.cn: 周一进行城市启动会和BD分配。每周四CM复盘各BDM团队进度和商家管道。15日前应达成60%目标。18日，达成不足60%的城市须提交业绩复盘和改进计划。24日前应达成100%目标。这个节奏确保我们及早发现问题并及时纠偏。
paragraphs.scene: Milestone planning / 里程碑规划

paragraphs.title: Incentive Scoring System
paragraphs.en: The new sign scoring system assigns 5 points per must-have merchant, 3 points per top-tier merchant, and 1 point per mid-tier merchant. If the merchant sets a marketing event with 30%+ off, the score is multiplied by a 1.2 coefficient. The conquering requirement is at least 30 operating hours and at least 3 orders within 30 days of launch. Manager performance score equals the sum of actual scores divided by 6 times the actual working BD headcount.
paragraphs.cn: 新签计分体系对必签商家每家5分、头部商家3分、腰部商家1分。如商户设置30%+折扣营销活动，得分乘以1.2系数。攻克条件为上线30天内营业至少30小时且至少3单。管理者绩效分=实际签约得分总和÷(6×实际工作BD人数)。
paragraphs.scene: Incentive policy explanation / 激励政策说明

paragraphs.title: Operating Rate KPI
paragraphs.en: The business objective is to prevent S/A merchant loss and maintain operating rates. The base score is 10 points. For every merchant that falls below the standard compared to last month, deduct 1 point. If a store that was previously underperforming successfully reverts, add 1 point. If a previously closed store resumes normal operations, add 1.5 points. The bonus is capped at 15 points and the deduction stops at 2 points to avoid large negative scores.
paragraphs.cn: 业务目标是防止S/A商户流失并维持营业率。基础分10分。每比上月少达标一家商户扣1分。如果之前不达标的商户成功逆转，加1分。如果之前停业的商户恢复正常营业，加1.5分。加分封顶15分，扣分最低2分，避免大面积负分。
paragraphs.scene: Operating rate KPI explanation / 营业率KPI说明

paragraphs.title: Smart Campaign Rollout
paragraphs.en: Keeta has launched its own smart campaign tool, which we are rolling out among SMB merchants to help them generate more orders with limited budgets. BDs' role is to drive merchant activation with higher budget. The process is: validate the merchant's eligibility, approach the merchant using the sales kit, guide the merchant to set their daily budget at a higher default level, and help the merchant enroll and confirm activation. Higher recommended budget gives merchants a better chance of generating more orders — extremely low budgets are quickly exhausted and typically yield only 1 to 3 orders.
paragraphs.cn: Keeta推出了自有智能营销工具，正在SMB商家中推广，帮助商家以有限预算获得更多订单。BD的角色是推动商家以更高预算激活。流程是：验证商家资格，用销售工具包接触商家，引导商家将日预算设置为更高默认档位，帮助商家注册并确认激活。更高的推荐预算能让商家有更大机会获得更多订单——极低预算很快耗尽，通常只能带来1-3单。
paragraphs.scene: Smart campaign rollout briefing / 智能营销推广说明

paragraphs.title: Deep Discount Strategy
paragraphs.en: The goal is to maintain the coverage of 30%+ off for the target pool with priority merchants at higher discount levels. The current 30%+ off coverage is 58%, with a DoD improvement of 2 percentage points and WoW improvement of 5 percentage points. The 40%+ off coverage is at 22.5%, still missing 1 p.p. from target. Action plan: focus on hitting the 40% off target, especially keeping promotions active for 7 days with at least 1 order, particularly for 2-star and 3-star classified merchants.
paragraphs.cn: 目标是维持目标池30%+折扣的覆盖率，优先推动重点商户做更高折扣。当前30%+off覆盖率58%，日环比+2pp，周环比+5pp。40%+off覆盖率22.5%，距目标仍差1pp。行动计划：聚焦达成40%off目标，特别是保持活动上线7天且至少1单，重点关注2星和3星分类商户。
paragraphs.scene: Promotion strategy briefing / 促销策略说明

paragraphs.title: Performance Analysis by Manager
paragraphs.en: The team's operation rate is stable, but campaign intelligence and deep discount remain differentiated across managers. Some CMs show 99% achievement hitting the same rate as last month, while others are at 98% and still closing in. We should replicate the playbooks of top performers and give focused support to managers below the threshold. Daniel improved 7 p.p. DoD, Victor grew 3 p.p., and Marcio added 2 p.p. for DoD coverage. For 40% off, Kingo, Fawzi, and Daniel each improved approximately 1 p.p. DoD.
paragraphs.cn: 团队营业率较稳定，但智能营销和深折在各管理者间仍有分化。部分CM以99%达成率与上月持平，其他CM在98%正在追赶。我们应复制优秀者的打法，为未达门槛的管理者提供专项支持。Daniel日环比+7pp，Victor +3pp，Marcio +2pp。40%off方面，Kingo、Fawzi和Daniel各日环比提升约1pp。
paragraphs.scene: Manager performance review / 管理者绩效复盘

paragraphs.title: Competitor Defense
paragraphs.en: We have found that 29 merchants show a significant decrease in operating hours, operating days, and average daily orders over the past two months. Some are suspected to have been exclusively acquired by competitors, and no feedback was received previously. Please notify the team today for feedback on this issue. Next, we will use no-code monitoring tools to track the abnormal business situation of top-1000 merchants, requiring CM feedback on the same day and DBR review the next day.
paragraphs.cn: 我们发现29家商户在过去两个月的营业时长、营业天数和日均订单出现显著下降。部分疑似被竞对独家，且此前未收到反馈。请今天通知团队收集此问题的反馈。下一步，我们将使用无代码监控工具追踪头部1000家商户的经营异常，要求CM当天反馈、DBR次日复盘。
paragraphs.scene: Competitor defense and anomaly monitoring / 竞对防守与异常监控

paragraphs.title: Team Management Requirements
paragraphs.en: CM must arrive at the office before 9:30 every morning and take a photo to clock in. BDMs must arrive before 10:00 AM or go directly for shadow visits. Managers are not allowed to work from home. BDs must complete at least 5 effective in-person visits per day. BDMs must hold daily morning meetings with BDs at least 3 times a week. Weekly reports must be completed by Sunday. Failure to meet these standards will result in performance deductions according to SMB management mechanisms.
paragraphs.cn: CM每天必须9:30前到达办公室并拍照打卡。BDM必须10:00前到办公室或直接去陪访。管理者不允许在家办公。BD每天须完成至少5个线下有效拜访。BDM须每日与BD开早会，每周至少3次。周报须在周日前完成。未达标将按SMB管理机制进行绩效扣分。
paragraphs.scene: Management routine and attendance / 管理日常与出勤要求

paragraphs.title: Best-Practice Replication
paragraphs.en: We need to take the process of the best BDs and scale it to the rest of the team. The goal is to equalize BD quality through a shared process, visit checklist, scenario-based training, and on-the-job field coaching. Key training topics include: process management — how to follow up and coach BDs rather than just push targets; competitor defense strategies; system and tool usage; team culture building; AI tools usage; and PDCA methodology. Training should include games, breaks, and prizes to maintain energy and engagement.
paragraphs.cn: 我们需要将最佳BD的流程推广到全团队。目标是通过共享流程、拜访清单、场景化培训和现场辅导拉齐BD能力。关键培训主题包括：过程管理——如何跟进和辅导BD而非仅压目标；竞对防御策略；系统/工具使用；团队文化建设；AI工具使用；PDCA方法论。培训应包含游戏、休息和奖品，保持参与度。
paragraphs.scene: Training & best-practice replication / 培训与标杆复制

paragraphs.title: Organization Wins Together
paragraphs.en: Our ultimate goal is to win. The success of the organization is greater than the success of any individual or market. When the organization wins, every team and every individual wins together. Let's step into August united by our shared management philosophy: Customer Success, Develop People, Know-How, and Win.
paragraphs.cn: 我们的终极目标是赢。组织的成功高于任何个人或单一市场的成功。当组织获胜时，每个团队和个人都会共同获胜。让我们带着共同的管理理念——客户成功、培养人才、方法论、赢——一起迈入八月。
paragraphs.scene: Team rally & philosophy / 团队动员与理念宣导
